name: search_hotels
description: Search for available hotels on Expedia by destination and dates. Returns up to 25 hotel listings with per-night price, total price, guest rating (out of 10), review count, refund policy, and a direct booking URL. Uses CDP browser execution to bypass Akamai bot detection.

params.name: destination
params.description: City or place name to search (e.g. "Miami Beach" or "Paris, France")

response_fields.name: listings
response_fields.description: Array of hotel listings, each with: name, price_per_night, price_total, rating, rating_label, reviews_count, refundable, url

response_fields.name: listings_count
response_fields.description: Total number of listings found on the page

response_fields.name: search_url
response_fields.description: Direct Expedia search URL for reference

response_fields.name: destination
response_fields.description: Resolved destination name from Expedia typeahead

response_fields.name: region_id
response_fields.description: Expedia region ID for the resolved destination
